pages.text: Aspects come in many forms and can have differing effects and cultivation styles. $(br)You can learn aspects through manuals, tribulations, breaking blocks, and or killing entities. $(br)Generator aspects generate an amount of elemental energy. $(br2)Converter aspects convert elemental energy into cultivation speed and elemental foundation.

System Gathering Aspects allow for the technique to be valid and for it to have a properly assigned system attached to it. $(br)Transformation Aspects transform the user and increase stats gained through body cultivation. $(br2)Demonic Aspects allow for power through consumption. $(br2)Conditional Generators are like normal generator, but they can vary in output through enviromental conditions.
